page.layout: One printed page. Running head with page number at top. Below it a grammar table: Greek forms in columns to the right, with small italic labels in the left margin beside them. Headings in capitals and small italic subheads run through the page. A note line at the foot right ("Co-") is a catchword.

main_text.head: INFINITIVVS.
main_text.l: Facere, uel fieri. Præsens. ποιεῖσθαι εἶσθαι.
main_text.head: PARTICIPIVM.
main_text.l: Hic facies uel fiens. ὁ ποιούμενος ἡ ποιουμένη τὸ ποιούμενον ποιούμενον τὸ ποιουμένου ἡμένης.
ἡ ποιουμένη ἡμένη τῆς ποιουμένης ἡμένης.
τὸ ποιούμενον ποιούμενον τὸ ποιουμένου ἡμένου.
main_text.head: INDICATIVVS.
main_text.p: Clamo ἐοάω ὦ ἐοάεις ἀς ἐοάει ἐοᾷ. (uel Dorice ἐοῆς ἐοῆ.)

page.notes: Greek forms are transcribed from a small, worn print; many accents and breathings are uncertain and may not match the printed letters exactly. Left-margin labels are treated as notes. The "Co-" at the foot right is treated as a catchword. Dialect and accents in the last lines are especially doubtful.
